notes.title: Dawnlands Gameplay Walkthrough Live Stream
notes.content:
[b][h1]We are happy to announce that the demo version of Dawnlands is a part of Steam Next Fest February 2023 Edition! 💪[/h1][/b]

[h3]You can play our demo right now! Just go to the Steam page, and you will see a green banner, hit the "Download" button and start your journey.
Don't miss out and catch up on all the exciting things in Dawnlands. Thank you so much for playing our demo! [/h3]

Don't forget to join our Discord to follow the lastest informationo about Dawnalnds 
https://discord.gg/TEXAyTgcuc
